command-palette.$description: CommandPalette. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

width.$description: Preferred width. Wide enough for a title, its group and a shortcut on one line; the palette still shrinks to the viewport minus a 1rem margin on each side.

item-height.$description: Minimum result height, one step over the control height: 36px at default density (unchanged), 40px comfortable, 32px compact.

item-selected-background.$description: The Qeet selected tint for the active result — the library's selected vocabulary, surface.brand-subtle. Dark brand-subtle is translucent, so on the overlay surface it separates at 1.20:1 (light 1.16:1) and keeps text.primary ≥11:1; the private overlay mix this used to be is within ΔE00 3 of it. The ≥3:1 cue is the border.brand indicator bar, not this tint.
